title: Legally Enforceable Hate Speech Detection for Public Forums
findings: Religion/Religious beliefs is a protected group under all eleven legal and policy definitions of hate speech used in the study, and is one of the most frequently targeted groups in the annotated dataset. However, the paper does not provide a specific breakdown of model performance on detecting hate speech against religious groups versus other protected categories. The general finding is that larger models like GPT-4 perform best on the overall task, but their reasoning is often flawed.
